name: SHEEP burn deflates every reflected balance, the pair's included
summary: SHEEP (a reflection CoinToken) burn(value) subtracts value from the caller's reflected balance and from _tTotal but not from _rTotal, so each call raises the reflection rate and shrinks every non-excluded balance, the PancakeSwap pair's included, by a common factor. With 380 WBNB flash-borrowed from DODO the attacker bought 25.6bn SHEEP, burned its own balance 106 times until rounding left the pair 2 base units against its 27, called sync() and sold them for 389.54 WBNB, taking 9.54 of the pair's 38.47 WBNB.
notes: Reset: deployment (April 2021); resets.mjs shows only balance and supply changes from trading since, and the exploit needed no fee or exclusion change. SHEEP Transfer-to-zero logs from deployment to after the anchor show no earlier transaction in which one account burned more than three times (the two with three are aggregator multi-hop swaps), so the anchor is the first burn loop; the pair's largest later WBNB outflow (0x28161b9a, 21.57 WBNB) is an LP's removeLiquidity.

Loss is the pair's net WBNB outflow. The SHEEP that left the pair and the 817m SHEEP burned from the token contract's own balance are valued at nothing beyond it (rule 12), as the drain left SHEEP without a market; holders' deflated balances are not counted.
